items.title: Sid Davilla Interview, 1969-04-17
items.q: You'd go down and you'd ask Dave Frank or somebody, a fellow named Frank Arena

ctx.x: Tell me now about your uncle.

Oh, my Uncle Joe. Yeah, he was a killer. He wrote some songs around the turn of the century. Uh, yeah, he used to have some copies somewhere. I remember, in particular one time, they'd write up in a newspaper about him. He, um, around the turn of the century, around the first war, something like that. There was a series of murders in New Orleans. And these people were bludgeoning to death with an axe. Uh, and he wrote a song called The Axe Man Blooms. I don't know where he got the title from, because I don't know…
